movie_details.title: Oosaravelli
movie_details.overview: Tony (Jr. NTR), a carefree man who takes on any job for money. During a trip to Kashmir, he falls in love with Niharika (Tamannaah), only to discover she is engaged to a powerful politician’s son. As Tony continues a mysterious killing spree, a hidden past between him and Niharika begins to unfold, revealing a deeper emotional connection and a mission driven by revenge. Blending romance, action, and suspense, the film builds toward an intense and emotional payoff.
